summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting a second amended and restated side letter to an existing revolving credit facility. Golub Capital Private Income Fund S's wholly-owned subsidiary GPIF S Funding, as borrower, amended its BANA Credit Facility with Bank of America, N.A. as agent. The amendment modifies the minimum utilization level for calculating the unused commitment fee through September 30, 2026. No new debt issuance, change in capital structure, or special situation event is present. This is a routine credit agreement amendment common for BDCs, not a special situation.
